sources.summary: Promotion: American furniture design brand Herman Miller has been honing its Aeron office chair for decades, equipping it with innovative materials and features for modern workplaces. Featuring an ergonomic form that supports sitters of different sizes and technological enhancements for better long-term sitting, Aeron was first designed in 1994 by Bill Stumpf and Don Chadwick. The post Herman Miller updates Aeron Chair to ensure its "lasting design" appeared first on Dezeen .
